description:
One library path a service files into, and what moving the data location does
to it.

because.description: Why it does or does not, in the operator's terms.

carried.description: Whether the library at this path survives the move.

host.description:
The host directory it would resolve to after the move, where the move can
resolve it at all.

path.description: The path as that service holds it, which is a path inside its container.
